correctness.rationale: Reconstructed RESULT.md lines 28–55. A size-n^2 nonattacking set hits each vertical fibre once. On the underlying subgroup the horizontal projection is thus an additive isomorphism, so an affine placement is a graph of the homomorphism with unique ordered slopes and offset. For a nonvertical queen direction the displacement scalar must annihilate ad_1+bd_2-d_3; a nonzero annihilator always produces a nonzero horizontal displacement since a pivot is ±1. This proves the unit criterion over arbitrary composite moduli. Independently counted the prime-field slopes without relying on the frozen rational incidence enumeration: for T={0,±1} and a outside T, forbidden b are in T, T+a, T-a. For p>=7 they form nine elements except at the four distinct a=±2,±1/2. At a=±2 the unshifted set meets each shifted set in one element and the shifted sets are disjoint; at a=±1/2 only the two shifted sets meet, in two elements. Thus each exceptional row has seven forbidden b and the count is (p-7)(p-9)+4(p-7)=(p-5)(p-7), including zero for p=7. For p=2,3 every a is forbidden; for p=5 the only candidates a,b=±2 force a±b=0. Lifting each surviving slope independently modulo p^e gives p^(2(e-1)) lifts; CRT and n offsets give the stated product, including 264, 624 and 351384. This agrees with the frozen 12-line incidence calculation. Inspected verify_affine_queens.py and the recorded replay without running the uploaded script; those tests do not supply the all-modulus proof or enumerate nonaffine placements.

broader_coverage.reasoning: Prior queens existence does not by itself give a count. The exact arrangement theorem supplies the nontrivial local count missing from that existence result; ordinary unit lifting then extends it to composite boards.

evidence: The vertical direction requires a unit last coefficient in any nonattacking normal-vector representation; projection also proves every affine size-n^2 coset has the normalized graph form. The known annihilator argument is equivalent to the twelve Catalan exclusions on the two remaining slopes.

For every p>=11 the intersection lattice is preserved: nonparallel determinants have absolute value at most two; rational pair intersections have denominators at most two and no new incidences or coincidences can arise, since nonzero coordinate differences and line evaluations after clearing denominators have numerators of absolute value less than seven.

Bad small-prime cases already cannot attain n^2 by the known existence theorem in dimension three. For the other primes, count mod p, lift two residues independently, apply CRT and multiply by n offsets.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The general finite-field theorem's 'sufficiently large' alone is not the uniform statement; the explicit small-integer good-reduction check and the known zero cases resolve that difference without another substantive enumerative theorem. The all-modulus product is mechanically implied.

originality.rationale: The proposed local enumeration is exactly the m=1 extended Catalan arrangement of type B2, with the already known affine characteristic polynomial (t-5)(t-7). The generic local count follows from the finite-field method. The same attack-model literature already provides the hyperplane/unit argument and excludes all moduli with a prime divisor below 11. No separate printed statement of the final composite-modulus formula was verified; the FAIL is for demonstrable implication, not a claim that the same displayed product previously appeared in queens terminology.
